Seeing Beyond the Sensors: HERE Showcases AI-Powered Map Data with Snapdragon Ride

January 6, 2026 HERE Technologies HERE Technologies, Qualcomm, Snapdragon Ride, CES 2026, ADAS, Electronic Horizon, Autonomous Driving, AI Maps
Read the source article

Quick summary

HERE Technologies and Qualcomm demonstrate at CES 2026 how AI-powered map data creates an "electronic horizon" that extends vehicle perception far beyond onboard sensors.

Key takeaways

  • HERE and Qualcomm integrate AI-powered mapping with Snapdragon Ride Pilot for enhanced vehicle perception
  • The "electronic horizon" prepares vehicles for road changes before physical sensors detect them
  • Map layers provide extended awareness beyond traditional line-of-sight limitations
  • Lane-level accuracy enables smoother autonomous driving with detailed topology data
  • HERE ADAS map coverage expands to over 100 countries by 2026
  • The system supports EU Intelligent Speed Assistance mandate and other regulatory requirements
